cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(lvgl_touch_contract LANGUAGES C CXX ASM)
set(LV_BUILD_CONF_PATH "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/lv_conf.h" CACHE PATH "" FORCE)
set(CONFIG_LV_BUILD_EXAMPLES OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(CONFIG_LV_BUILD_DEMOS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(CONFIG_LV_USE_THORVG_INTERNAL OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
add_subdirectory("${LVGL_SOURCE}" lvgl)
add_executable(touch_oracle runtime.cpp)
target_compile_features(touch_oracle PRIVATE cxx_std_17)
target_compile_options(touch_oracle PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Werror -UNDEBUG)
target_include_directories(touch_oracle PRIVATE
  "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../../esphome/components/lvgl_touch_diagnostic")
target_link_libraries(touch_oracle PRIVATE lvgl::lvgl m)
target_link_options(touch_oracle PRIVATE "-Wl,--wrap=malloc,--wrap=calloc,--wrap=realloc")
